origin.rerun: git ls-tree origin/main research/queue/ | grep -oE 'RQ-[0-9]{8}-[0-9]+' | sort | uniq -d  (empty is not proof; also diff hand-authored vs queue_replenish.py-minted IDs on open PRs: git diff origin/main...<branch> --name-only -- research/queue); then check whether queue_replenish.py still allocates from the same RQ-YYYYMMDD-NNN space as hand-authored units

what: ROOT CAUSE of the 2026-10-05 RQ-20261004-653..661 collision on PR #16386: queue_replenish.py (generated E35/M20 units) and hand-authored research units mint IDs from the same RQ-YYYYMMDD-NNN space and neither sees open PRs, so a long-lived PR collides with main once the generator catches up (fixed by hand-renumbering 653..674 -> 753..774). Proposed fix: give generated units a separate namespace (e.g. RQ-YYYYMMDD-G-NNN) or a reserved numeric range, and have queue_replenish.py skip IDs present on any open PR branch; add a guard that fails a PR whose new research/queue ids already exist on origin/main under different content.
